purpose: Proposed plan to replace source-driven Semantic Scholar ML collection with publisher-authoritative proceedings membership and paper-specific affiliation evidence. This file is planning metadata; it does not change the registry, cache, or site.

initial_ranking_window.proposal: Use a common continuous window for the first default-on decision. Keep 2026 partial until complete official inventories are available. Stage older years only after separate membership and affiliation gates pass; do not interpret excluded years as zero output.

current_site_ml_years.interpretation: Derived institution/year output rows; not evidence of accepted-paper membership completeness.

membership_source.authority: Official NeurIPS proceedings archive and linked proceedings book pages; use each edition's paper IDs, paper URLs, and track labels.

verified_2025_counts.note: The book's 5,823 entries span listed tracks; the fact sheet's 5,290 is main-track accepts. Reconcile track scope and IDs; these are not equivalent denominators.

membership_source.track_policy_proposal: Include research tracks in the official main-conference proceedings under a declared policy; preserve every track label. Exclude workshops and the separate Creative AI book by default. Treat 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks as a separate book and 2022 onward as a track within the main proceedings.

neurips.affiliation_strategy: First exact DOI join to OpenAlex work.authorships with DOI/title/year/byline identity checks; then DOI-specific Crossref author affiliations; then final NeurIPS proceedings PDF author/affiliation blocks. DBLP signature affiliations may be a secondary cross-check after year coverage validation. Never use S2/OpenReview author profiles for historical credit.
blockers: The current S2/OpenAlex source-driven discovery is incomplete because proceedings papers are often attributed to arXiv or another source.
Track membership/counts need exact reconciliation, especially 2025: 5,823 proceedings book entries versus 5,290 fact-sheet main-track accepts.
The 1987-present archive requires a declared track policy and separate historical PDF affiliation work; 2017 is the proposed initial common ranking window.

membership_source.authority: Official PMLR ICML edition volume and canonical article slugs; enumerate the conference volume only, not workshop volumes.
membership_source.pre_pmlr_note: ICML proceedings predate PMLR; for 2010-2012 use official ICML archive adapters only after separate validation. Earlier years are outside the initial window.

icml.affiliation_strategy: First exact DOI join to OpenAlex work.authorships with DOI/title/year/byline identity checks; then DOI-specific Crossref author affiliations; then final PMLR paper PDF author/affiliation blocks. Use official volume membership independent of OpenAlex source venue. DBLP signature affiliations may be a secondary cross-check after year coverage validation. Never use author profiles for historical credit.
blockers: No reliable OpenAlex ICML venue source; known OpenAlex venue source is contaminated and works are often attributed to arXiv.
Crossref fuzzy container-title search has ICMLA/ICMLC lookalikes; PMLR volume 28 is the first ICML edition in PMLR (2013).
2025 official main-track accept count is 3,260 and must reconcile to volume 267 paper IDs; DOI/PDF affiliation completion remains unmeasured against official membership.

membership_source.authority: OpenReview accepted conference submissions keyed by year-specific venue ID, reconciled to ICLR's official proceedings page/list. Use API v1 for legacy years where required and API v2 for modern years.
membership_source.api_coverage_note: Official ICLR lists accepted papers for 2013-2025. API history is uneven: legacy forms for 2013-2014, 2015 absent from the public venue list, and the 2016 listing is reported as workshop-only in API analyses. Use archived official paper lists for 2015-2016 and reconcile them independently.

verified_2025_counts.note: One-record difference; reconcile accepted OpenReview IDs against final proceedings before accepting either as the target count.

iclr.affiliation_strategy: Use an exact OpenAlex DOI work.authorships match where a DOI exists; otherwise use DOI-specific Crossref if available, then extract the author-specific affiliation block from the final accepted ICLR proceedings PDF. OpenReview profile affiliations and Semantic Scholar author-profile affiliations are profile snapshots and are never historical evidence. Preserve author IDs only for identity matching, not institutional credit.
blockers: Current source-based harvest is structurally incomplete: ICLR papers are often attributed to arXiv, not an ICLR source.
OpenReview API v1/v2 and invitations vary by year; 2015-2016 need official archived-list recovery instead of assumed API coverage.
2025 fact sheet says 3,704 accepted while official proceedings lists 3,703 papers; resolve the exact missing/extra record.
Accepted submission metadata does not by itself establish historical affiliation; final-paper PDFs or identity-checked DOI metadata are required.

allowed: OpenAlex work.authorships joined by exact normalized DOI plus strong title, year, and byline identity checks
Crossref author affiliations attached to the DOI-specific work record
Author-to-affiliation mapping visibly printed in the final publisher proceedings paper
DBLP signature-level affiliation as a separately recorded, audited secondary source
forbidden_for_historical_credit: Current employer inferred from author identity/profile
affiliation_evidence_rules.provenance: Preserve raw affiliation string, source, source URL/DOI, extraction confidence, resolved institution IDs, and author-slot mapping separately.

phases.name: Freeze scope and comparison rules
phases.work: Define included research tracks, excluded workshops/side tracks, the initial 2017-2025 common window, and how official accepted lists will be reconciled.
phases.deliverable: Versioned source/track table and expected-count evidence per venue-year.

phases.name: ICLR 2025 pilot
phases.work: Implement membership-only OpenReview/official-proceedings retrieval, reconcile the 3,704/3,703 delta, then enrich DOI-bearing rows and sample final PDFs.
phases.deliverable: One complete staged year and measured API, DOI, PDF, affiliation, and resolution costs.

phases.name: Complete ICLR initial window
phases.work: Add API-year configuration for 2017-2024 and separately assess official 2015-2016 archive recovery.
phases.deliverable: Per-year membership and affiliation gates; no profile-derived historical credit.

phases.name: ICML PMLR adapter
phases.work: Enumerate conference volumes starting with 2025 volume 267, reconcile 3,260 main-track accepts, and backfill DOI/PDF affiliations for 2017-2025 before older editions.
phases.deliverable: Canonical PMLR rows with track/source provenance and per-year gates.

phases.name: NeurIPS track-aware adapter
phases.work: Pilot 2025 proceedings and fact-sheet reconciliation, then process 2017-2024 with explicit track handling; measure older 1987-2016 separately.
phases.deliverable: Canonical publisher membership with no workshop/Creative AI contamination and per-year affiliation report.

phases.name: Full reconciliation and promotion review
phases.work: Reconcile all staged rows to official accepted sets, deduplicate proceedings versus arXiv versions, aggregate in isolated staging, review gates and a separately approved known-strong tripwire.
phases.deliverable: A reviewable evidence report supporting a separate default_on decision.

publisher_membership_coverage.rule: At least 99% of official included accepted-paper IDs/titles represented and at least 99% of cache rows matched to an official included record; every delta explained by track/scope or source evidence.

affiliation_author_slot_coverage.rule: At least 90% of byline author slots have a paper-specific affiliation string or institution from OpenAlex work, DOI-specific Crossref, or final publisher paper; profiles do not count. Report author-slot and paper-level rates separately.

affiliation_resolution.rule: At least 95% of paper-specific affiliation strings resolved or manually adjudicated; report evidence availability separately from institution resolution.

identity_integrity: Exact normalized DOI plus strong title/year/byline checks for OpenAlex matches
gates.scope_purity: Every row maps to an official included proceedings ID/URL and allowed track; no workshop, rejected, or preprint-only duplicate remains. Audit 100 titles per large edition or all papers for editions under 100, plus every exception.
gates.official_count_reconciliation: Explain 2025 NeurIPS 5,823 book entries vs 5,290 main-track accepts, ICML 3,260 main-track accepts, and ICLR 3,704 accepted vs 3,703 proceedings entries. Maximum unexplained residual after scope alignment: 1%.
gates.known_strong_tripwire: Before activation, separately configure diverse known-strong ML institutions and require nonzero area credit; investigate zeroes as data defects. This plan does not edit the tripwire.
gates.window_completeness: All three venues pass every edition from 2017 through 2025. Keep 2026 partial until official inventories are complete; stage older years only when separately gated.

effort_estimate.basis: Planning estimate, not a measured quote. Replace after the ICLR 2025 pilot.
effort_estimate.openalex_doi_batches: At an assumed 45-60% DOI share and batches up to 100 DOI values, approximately 180-330 batches.
effort_estimate.openalex_list_attempts: Plan 250-450 attempts including paging, retries, and response-size splits; existing 58,145-row DOI recovery used 264 batches and 305 attempts.
effort_estimate.openreview_api: Likely tens of paginated calls for recent ICLR years, depending on API page size; official docs do not state a fixed public rate budget. Use low concurrency, checkpointing, and backoff.
effort_estimate.non_doi_affiliation_work: Likely 16,000-30,000 no/weak-DOI rows plus the 10,489 historical DOI-bearing OpenAlex misses; PDF extraction and QA dominate. Use text extraction first, OCR only when needed.
recommended_order: ICLR pilot first: modern accepted submissions are structured, and API/archival edge cases can be bounded before full collection.
ICML PMLR second: clean per-edition volume structure and a straightforward membership enumerator.
NeurIPS third: broad historical archive and track transitions make membership policy/QA the largest task.
